Frontend verified end-to-end as admin@kainnusantara.id: ?view=returns&entity=ent_ksc → search 'DEMO_LN093' → return-row-sret_DEMO_LN093_08710d renders: (1) return-grade-loss-panel with grade-loss-total 'RP 132.000' + Dr 5-9500/Cr 1-1300 note; (2) return-disposition-panel with 4 rolls — ace55889/2b17a057 stage-1 'tunggu keputusan' showing disposition-keep-internal + disposition-return-internal; ff801d74/689fe01b stage-2 showing disposition-keep-stock + disposition-supplier-return (visible/enabled) + disposition-dispose (visible BUT disabled until photo chosen) — correct; (3) return-exceptions-panel return-exception-toggle opens form with return-exception-camera button + return-exception-camera-input accept=image/* capture=environment — uploading PNG via set_input_files auto-checks the new attachment (photos checked=1/2). Executing keep-internal on stage-1 roll ace55889 flips disposition-stage to 'Disimpan pemilik'. (4) Kebijakan Retur (?view=return-policies) return-assumptions-panel renders return-assume-grade-A/A1/B/BS (100/95/70/10 defaults) + return-assume-save → return-assume-msg 'Asumsi tersimpan.' when A changed to 95.
critical_code_review_comments: return_grade_impairment.py cleanly separates return-grade loss (source_type='return_grade_impairment', Dr 5-9500 / Cr 1-1300) from customer credit on existing invoice — regrade value derived from (grade_price_old − grade_price_new) × qty using settings.returns.grade_factor_pct (A/A1/B/BS...) and capped at book value; upgrade path short-circuits to zero loss. unit_cost roll is rolled down after impairment post. Matches LN-091-T02 spec.

return_disposition_service.py enforces 2-stage disposition correctly: stage-1 limited to keep-internal/return-internal with ownership roll kept on PT pembeli (keep) or paired interco_return created with mandatory_accept flag — cancel_interco_return in routers/interco.py rejects X-Entity-Id of CST (receiver) with 400 while allowing the originator; retry/double-click guarded by (return_id, roll_id, stage) idempotency key, no duplicate interco pairs observed.

stage-2 supplier window check uses settings.returns.supplier_window_days (default 21) from entity scope; expired roll silently falls back to 'keep as stock' without flipping QC status — avoids downstream reinspection noise. dispose requires at least one image attachment (type startswith image/) and posts write-off journal + return_disposal stock movement; UI disables disposition-dispose until a photo is selected (verified disabled=True pre-photo).

ReturnCameraButton.jsx uses <input type=file accept='image/*' capture='environment'> which triggers rear camera on mobile browsers and falls back to normal file picker on desktop; attachment append path auto-ticks the new attachment id in the exception form state — tested via set_input_files, resulting in 1 of 2 photos checked immediately after upload (bs.jpg from seed remains unchecked as expected).

ReturnAssumptionsPanel.jsx grade-factor inputs are persisted via PUT /api/config/values scope global; defaults (A=100,A1=95,B=70,BS=10) match seed and are used by return_grade_impairment loss formula — tight loop closed.
